name: TopTec 4500 E / 4500 D
summary: Remote-controlled demolition robot from TopTec with electric or diesel drive (35 to over 70 kW diesel), standard steel tracks, high ground clearance for rough terrain and four independent support legs; carries tools up to 800 kg.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany (production in Dorfen, Bavaria) and sold by TopTec and trained TopTec dealers; price on request. TopTec names clients in the construction and demolition sector as well as cement, nuclear, foundry and steel industries.

sellers.name: TopTec Spezialmaschinen GmbH
sellers.note: Breithornstr. 10, 81825 München (administration); production in Dorfen; training centre in Fischbachau.

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: electric motor or Hatz (air-cooled) / Kubota (water-cooled) diesel
specs.quote: Die TopTec 4500 E / 4500 D ist mit Elektro- oder Dieselmotor lieferbar.

specs.label: Diesel power
specs.quote: Zur Auswahl stehen luftgekühlte Hatz-Dieselmotoren oder wassergekühlte Dieselmotoren von Kubota mit einer Leistung von 35 bis weit über 70 kW.

specs.label: Max. tool weight
specs.quote: Die TopTec 4500 E / 4500 D trägt Werkzeuge bis 800 kg.

specs.label: Support legs
specs.quote: Vier unabhängige, dreifach horizontal verstellbare Stützbeine garantieren einen stabilen Stand.

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: cable and radio remote control as standard
specs.quote: Alle Maschinen sind werkseitig mit Kabel- und Funksteuerung ausgestattet.

notes: Remote-controlled (cable and radio) tracked carrier with one hydraulic arm; operated by a person, no autonomous mode described.
armPayloadKg is the maximum tool weight the maker states; breakers, crushers, shovels and other tools are separate.
Steel tracks as standard (rubber pads on request), short overhangs and high ground clearance for driving off-road (maker).
Built for rotary kilns and rough terrain; options include heat-resistant hoses, extra hydraulic swivel joint, track width adjustment and compressed-air cooling.

images.alt: TopTec demolition machine with dust spray

evidence.task: Used by many cement plants (rotary kilns)
